contracts_rationale: Bug fix inside consolidation; no external interface (CLI flags, JSON envelopes, error codes) changes. The only new persisted key is an optional meta.json field documented in data-model.md.
friendly_name: Bound reconciliation windows at the Mission base (#7560)
purpose_context: On a fork, the target branch often does not contain the commit a Mission was cut from. Consolidation then reads pre-Mission history as Mission-authored and refuses the landing (DEPENDENCY_REF_COVERS_MISSION_WORK, or phantom un-attributable deletions), with no workaround. This Mission records the Mission's base commit and bounds every reconciliation window at it, without weakening refusals for genuine Mission work.
purpose_tldr: Let an integration Mission on a fork consolidate: history from before the Mission was created is never treated as Mission work.
